❄️❄️❄️TRAILS UPDATE❄️❄️❄️

February 7 ~ 7:15am

Current Temp: 25*F/-4*C
Current Weather: Clear. We are forecast for a sunny day with a high near 48*F.  

With the temps in the 50's by day and low 20's by night, our snowpack is still hanging on. However, it is taking longer each day to soften. 

Conditions are ideal for snowshoeing all day, fat biking in the morning and if the surface softens, classic skiing in the late afternoon. We are unable to groom at this time. Day Trail Passes are $1 until conditions improve. 

The most up to date details on the trails are posted at the Inn entryway. Happy Winter Carnival Weekend!

Reported on Feb 7, 2026 at 7:22 AM by TW
